peopleAlsoAsk: What's the difference between Thai fried rice and fried rice?
Why does Thai fried rice taste different?
What does Thai style fried rice taste like?
Why does Thai Fried Rice taste so good?

items.markdown:
![Authentic Thai Fried Rice Recipe (ข้าวผัด) - Street Food Style!](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280511-1672-0139-0000-3b1c29716282:6)
Thai fried rice, or *khao pad* , is `a popular street food dish made by stir-frying leftover jasmine rice with aromatics, eggs, vegetables, and a protein` . Unlike Chinese fried rice, it gets its distinct savory-sweet flavor from fish sauce and soy sauce, and is traditionally served with fresh cucumber, tomato, and lime wedges.[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/) [[1]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/)[[2]](https://www.feastingathome.com/thai-fried-rice/)[[3]](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/)

Key Characteristics

- **The Rice:** It is made using fragrant, slightly dry day-old jasmine rice, which gives it a softer bite and subtle floral aroma compared to the firmer long-grain rice used in Chinese versions.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) [[1]](https://www.skinnytaste.com/thai-fried-rice-575-pts/)[[2]](https://inquiringchef.com/thai-fried-rice/)
- **The Flavor Profile:** The seasoning relies heavily on fish sauce (providing a salty umami depth), light or dark soy sauce, and a touch of sugar for caramelization.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BvimqfvjjvA) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BvimqfvjjvA)[[2]](https://thewoksoflife.com/thai-fried-rice/)
- **The Aromatics:** It features bold additions like garlic, shallots, and chopped scallions.[](https://inquiringchef.com/thai-fried-rice/) 
- **The Garnish:** It is almost always accompanied by a squeeze of fresh lime juice and a condiment called *prik nam pla* (a mixture of fish sauce and chopped Thai chilies).[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/) 

Common Variations While standard Thai fried rice usually features chicken (*khao pad gai* ) or shrimp (*khao pad goong* ), there are several popular variations depending on the ingredients mixed in:[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/) [[1]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/)[[2]](https://www.tiktok.com/@dimsimlim/video/7589395475086789908)

- **Khao Pad Kaphrao:** Fried rice packed with fresh holy basil, garlic, and chilies.
- **Khao Pad Rotfai ("Train Fried Rice"):** A nostalgic, old-school version made with dark soy sauce, Chinese broccoli, and tomatoes.
- **Khao Pad Amerikan ("American Fried Rice"):** A fusion dish developed during the Vietnam War, mixing ketchup directly into the rice and serving it alongside fried chicken, hot dogs, and a fried egg.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BvimqfvjjvA) [[1]](https://theforkedspoon.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe/)[[2]](https://www.hungryhuy.com/thai-basil-fried-rice/)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thai_fried_rice)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/mariongrasby/posts/thai-railway-fried-rice-if-you-dont-know-you-should/909654190621102/)

How It's Prepared The ingredients are cooked quickly over high heat in a wok. The rice is often pushed to the side of the wok so the sauce can be poured directly into the hot center to caramelize slightly before tossing it all together. Vegetables like Chinese broccoli, onion, and tomatoes are frequently added, and it is generally topped with or accompanied by a fried egg.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BvimqfvjjvA) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ZSeUJScWqTI)For a visual breakdown of how traditional Thai fried rice is prepared in street food stalls:For a visual breakdown of how traditional Thai fried rice is prepared in street food stalls:![](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRv-ayLKMgYyLrzOvhz4cFNVqbeWqGl7Tu2HFxecHJuHLL3zy-YRQknORTOy-lQ2VXpcywuZNjoybmj5yRsLA35TNbnXA)
